findings.detail: The CAD token is the Par currency, but cost_currency was populated as U_CAD even though Cost is in the USD valuation column.

rationale: Class 2 within-row localization. The source table header places Par before separate Cost and Fair Value columns. CAD appears in the par-currency position on the cited investment row, while the Canada subtotal prints dollar markers for Cost and Fair Value. The extracted cost_currency value U_CAD therefore reflects leakage from the Par currency column into the Cost currency field, not a valid CAD-denominated BDC valuation field.
